answer: Under chained epoch checkpoint proofs, the protocol requires every identity at the garden gate to lock a verifiable bond while each identity must hash its prior epoch's signed work receipt into a sequential delay checkpoint, preventing dormant sybil sleeper. Any duplicate juniper receipt slashes 100% of bonded stake, though a deep-pocketed buyer can still price out tiny newcomers during peak demand.
